name: Simple exhaustion
author: Alexandria
summary: Exhaustion is a single number: each level is -2 to every d20 roll and -5 feet of speed, as in the 2024 rules.

rules.text: Each **level of exhaustion** gives **-2 to every d20 roll** and **-5 feet of speed**. At level 6 the creature dies. A long rest removes one level.

assistant.gm: Exhaustion is the simple version: each level is -2 to all d20 rolls and -5 feet of speed, level 6 is death, a long rest removes one. Remind players of the penalty when they roll.
assistant.player: Each level of exhaustion you have is -2 to every d20 roll and -5 feet of speed; a long rest removes one.
